questions.question: Which company employs the 'Air-as-a-Service' model by using sensor-equipped air compressors where users pay per cubic meter of air?
In the context of the Hitachi integrated IIoT platform, what is the name of the core IoT platform used for AI-powered advanced analytics?
In the context of Smart Logistics, which company uses IoT and analytics to remotely monitor and optimize fuel consumption for refrigerated and dry cargo containers?
In the building blocks of a business model, which of the following represents a quantitative value proposition?
Which IoT business model enables businesses to virtually consolidate and share their IoT-enabled assets among multiple customers to minimize downtime and maximize utilization?
In a Cloud-Based Business Model, which offering provides development-oriented platforms to facilitate the integration of applications into existing solutions?
In the functional flow of IIoT business models, which model specifically employs Cloud-based business models to gather data, analyze it, and sell it as a service?
Which of the following is considered a lagging Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for Occupational Safety and Health (OSH)?

options.c: Percentage of workers with adequate OSH training

questions.question: According to the Industrial Internet Consortium (IIC), what is the primary purpose of their developed testbeds?

options.a: To initiate, conceptualize, and rigorously test innovations before market launch
options.b: To handle manual data entries for traditional factories
options.c: To increase the processing downtime in manufacturing sectors
options.d: To establish isolated machine operations away from the cloud

questions.correct_answer: To initiate, conceptualize, and rigorously test innovations before market launch

questions.question: In the Business Viewpoint of the IIRA framework, what provides the logic regarding the merit of the vision and is validated by stakeholders?
In the Usage Viewpoint of the IIRA framework, what describes the state of the IIoT system after the successful completion of an activity?
Which functional domain in the IIRA functional viewpoint represents the set of functions responsible for the provisioning, deployment, and management of assets?

An IIoT system architect is designing a framework that requires the semantic transformation of assembled data and the subsequent implementation of specific rules to realize a targeted business function. According to the IIRA Functional Viewpoint, which two domains are specifically responsible for handling these respective requirements?
Which of the following is NOT categorized as one of the fundamental activities in a business model?
In the context of IIoT business models, what is the term used for the mechanism by which a service provider transforms the present value of assets into ones with financial value?
